review.rationale: AF-CTR-06 author source and licence assessment at 41e1c4e25fd61cdd7d3352c3be8a332bb4434a4e; independent PR review and pushed-head native full gates remain pending. The current Go image changes only the zero-valued no-proxy transport literal in the self-host bridge readiness client; behavior remains no system proxy. The provider verification code removes a non-null assertion after checking the unique result and equivalently formats its identifier. A test fixture fills a real unread loopback socket before exercising the unchanged 240 KiB replay frame, observes an actual blocked TCP write and checks the original deadline and UNKNOWN result on Windows and Linux. These are author component tests, not Node filesystem or overall acceptance. Profile r112 extends r111 with the changed 426-file image input closure and unchanged Worker and platform bridge asset identities. The Linux bridge is the delivered 615.1 OCI executable and the Windows bridge is the separately built reviewed 8e5 source; each retains Contracts 437.1 source and legal closure, while the current runtime uses published Contracts 450.1. Existing image bases, other runtime dependencies and legal bytes are unchanged. r58 extends r57; all earlier records are preserved. This is not independent approval or a release.
